business.description: Dhanvantri Jeevan Rekha Limited operates in the healthcare sector, providing hospital and related medical services including general specialties and advanced super-specialty services such as Cardiology, Gastroenterology, Neurology, Urology, Nephrology, Internal Medicine, Pulmonology and comprehensive diagnostic care.

products.name: Hospital and medical services
products.note: Operating Income Rs 2585.84 Lakhs for FY 2025-26

products.name: Multi-specialty hospital and diagnostic services
products.note: Includes Cardiology, Gastroenterology, Neurology, Urology, Nephrology, Internal Medicine, Pulmonology, Orthopedics and other diagnostic and support services

products.name: Diagnostic and therapeutic services
products.note: Includes Cath Lab services: Angiography, Angioplasty, Pacemaker Implantation, Valvuloplasty

customers: Patients in Meerut and surrounding region
Government Sponsored Schemes including CGHS, ECHS, ESI, Ayushmaan

outlook.statement: The outlook for the Indian healthcare sector remains positive, supported by increasing demand for quality medical services, greater health awareness, expansion of health insurance and government-supported healthcare programmes, and continuing technological advancement. The Company will continue to focus on improving utilisation of its existing facilities, strengthening specialised services, maintaining quality standards, enhancing patient experience and adopting appropriate technology, while continuing to manage operating costs prudently.

risks: Increasing costs of medical consumables, medicines, utilities, equipment and maintenance

Cost and availability of medical consumables and equipment

operating costs growing faster than revenue
depreciation increasing due to medical equipment additions

margin compression from cost growth exceeding revenue growth
